evidence.quote: For image and video tasks, input images beyond the model’s free allowance incur a fixed fee converted into Credits. These excess input-image fees do not receive membership discounts. See [model pricing](https://agnes-ai.com/en/docs/pricing) for each model’s free allowance and excess rate.
